query:
UPDATE projects
SET project_owner_id = $2,
    project_type_id = $3,
    name = $4,
    slug = $5,
    description = $6,
    formatted_address = $7,
    city = $8,
    area = $9,
    state_or_province = $10,
    postal_code = $11,
    latitude = $12,
    longitude = $13,
    rera_number = $14,
    rera_authority = $15,
    total_land_area = $16,
    towers_count = $17,
    floors_count = $18,
    units_count = $19,
    start_date = $20,
    launch_date = $21,
    possession_date = $22,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL;
